source: a game where you have a garage and make money and hire workers limited people 4 players. there is roads and your friends walking around well you ask them for a job so you can unlock the garage buisness

answers.ask: Do the four players share one garage, or does each get their own plot?
answers.answer: Each of the up to four players gets their own garage plot, so they can build their own garage business and hire workers.

answers.ask: Does a round end when the garage is fully built out, or is it a persistent world you keep coming back to?
answers.answer: It is a persistent world where players keep returning to earn money, hire workers, and unlock more of their garage business.

config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Simulation map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Shared Persistent World: No personal plot at all — one common world everybody operates in together.

INCLUDE:
- Task Station: A built station in the job loop - a pickup bay, a delivery dock, a patient bed, a planting plot.
- Progression Circulation: Walkable or drivable circulation chaining the hub to wherever value is actually produced.
- Hauling Routes: Vehicle-width roads between extraction ground and processing structures.
